title: Lunacy Audio Nova is a place to build and sell your own AI-powered music plug-ins
summary: Lunacy, purveyor of fine VST plug-ins like Cube, a synth that you control by moving a ball around a 3D space, has just launched Nova, a platform where creators can build custom music tools using AI and sell them to others.
